_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is coiled inside Complacency with only ~6% of 12h windows moving ±2pts; diverging 2019 top drivers plus flat funding argue range persistence, not a rung break.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on phase but inflow print supports caution not chase; no directional conflict
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC rangebound, fear_greed ~45-65, funding near flat across next several 12h windows
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G and 30d momentum both push mid-70s (up) or vol spike plus breakdown drops heat composite under 39 (down into Anxiety)
